pipelines..github/workflows/hb_electronics-pipelin:
name: hb_electronics-pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
      - name: Test
        run: |
          npm test -- --watch=false
pipelines..github/workflows/gestiondestock-pipelin:
name: gestiondestock-pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build
        run: |
          mvn -B clean package -DskipTests
      - name: Test
        run: |
          mvn -B test
